title: LA Metro breaks ground on 12-mile bus rapid transit corridor
summary: The project will upgrade 26 bus stations along the route and connect with multiple rail lines and other bus routes.

title: Seattle social housing hits milestone with land acquisition
summary: The Seattle Social Housing Developer Board will build around 20 mixed-income homes in the city’s Central District. It expects to own 1,000 homes by the end of next year.

title: Local impacts of high transportation costs
summary: Inflation hits commuters, drivers and fliers, according to Bureau of Transportation Statistics data. The impacts can change residents' travel, dining and shopping plans.

title: High housing costs are driving poverty in these 10 states
summary: Above-average housing prices are canceling out the impact of antipoverty programs such as SNAP in some states, a Pew Charitable Trusts analysis found.

title: Global conflicts, local consequences: Cities confront rising threats, violence sparked by international events
summary: The Israel-Hamas war has tested U.S. community leaders’ ability to protect residents and maintain social cohesion. A standing crisis protocol can help cities prepare, experts say.

title: Good luck finding parking in these big US cities: Inrix report
summary: Drivers in downtown areas must choose between searching for on-street parking or paying high fees at public parking lots and garages, the transportation analytics company found.

title: Google unveils agentic AI for government services
summary: The Gemini offering is capable of policy analysis, Freedom of Information Act redactions and assisting with procurement compliance, the company says.

title: NYC ‘sanctuary’ rules upheld in court
summary: Citing state sovereignty and the 10th Amendment, a federal judge dismissed the Trump administration’s attempt to override New York City’s restrictions on immigration enforcement cooperation.

title: Housing policies on the ballot: What 4 states are asking voters to decide this year
summary: From zoning regulations to bond approvals, the six statewide housing measures up for a vote in November are the most in a single year since 2006, Ballotpedia says.

title: Got Flock cameras? 6 things to consider
summary: Involve residents, scrutinize vendor contracts, establish clear usage rules and track whether automated license plate readers improve public safety before adopting or expanding the technology, experts say.
